lanes.goal: collect provider production boundary, cost quota, incident recovery, rollback, outcome, and learning-loop evidence into one release candidate chain
lanes.stop_condition: stop if release wording implies live provider execution or production safety proof

lanes.goal: make the release delta understandable as a capability, not as internal audit machinery
lanes.expected_output: capability-first README, matrix, and release notes alignment
lanes.stop_condition: stop if capability value is hidden behind artifact-count claims

join_packet.conflict_summary: No unresolved lane conflict; both lanes state go/no-go as a candidate evidence bundle, not live production execution.
join_packet.blocker_summary: No active blocker for releasing the bounded candidate; live provider execution and third-party validation remain outside scope.
join_packet.merge_rationale: Provider readiness evidence and capability-first explanation are joined by TASK-118 release definition, release notes, and release-state audit.

not_proven: Parallel lane evidence does not prove live external provider execution, provider credential readiness, third-party operator acceptance, or production safety.
